  - *Assessment* (at the client): **1 Settings → 2 Code → 3 Run → 4 Share the zip**. Settings need only the source
    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...).     when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...).     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...).     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...).     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...).     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...).     when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...).     when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...).     when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and

    system. Run makes the zip. **Share the zip** does not send anything: it shows where the zip is, its size and
    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in.     what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.

    what is inside, who to send it to (Wishtree, optional CC) and a ready-made message the client's team can copy
    when they share the file (e-mail, OneDrive, SharePoint...). At the bottom, **Send mail with the zip attached** opens a new e-mail (Outlook) with To, CC, subject, message and the zip attached - nothing is sent until someone checks it and presses Send; without Outlook the default mail program opens with the text and the zip's folder opens to drag the file in. Projects opened from a package also get **Fix code**.
